verdict.rationale: Stripe docs describe stablecoin payments settling into the merchant's Stripe balance 'in your local currency' (docs-18) and Connect stablecoin payouts converting fiat balances for payout (docs-23), implying an off-ramp path, but there is no documented published list of eligible currencies/countries for this off-ramp, and community hands-on commentary explicitly contradicts a smooth conversion, noting that de-tokenizing USDC back into fiat 'comes with restrictions, delays and fees' (stripe-crypto-comm-9), plus reports that payouts in crypto are restricted to individuals/sole proprietors (stripe-crypto-comm-8), undercutting the 'documented rails across a published set' claim. missing for 10: an explicit published table of supported off-ramp currencies/countries, and independent confirmation that conversion to bank transfer is fast/fee-transparent as documented.
